## Summary

<!-- 1–3 bullets explaining what changed and why. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new tool / transport / config field
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] docs — README, docs/, JSDoc
- [ ] test — added or fixed tests
- [ ] refactor — internal change, no behavior diff
- [ ] chore — deps, CI, config
- [ ] BREAKING CHANGE

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run test` passes (coverage thresholds met)
- [ ] Updated `docs/` if user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] Conventional Commit title (e.g. `feat(filesystem): add glob support`)
